title: Everyday Phrases — At the Barber Shop
scene_zh: 在理髮店 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi, are you open this morning?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💈 實用在理髮店必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Barber Shop
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用在理髮店情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從進門排隊選髮型、溝通長度漸層鬢角、修剪洗頭造型閒聊，到收尾付款小費與下次預約，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Barber Shop phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the full barber journey: walking in and choosing a style, talking about length, fades and sideburns, the cut, wash and styling chat, and finishing up with payment, tips and the next appointment. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, are you open this morning?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，你們今天上午有開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we opened at nine sharp.
dialogue.zh: 有的，我們九點準時開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need an appointment today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不用，今天直接來也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people are ahead of me?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl ɑr əˈhɛd ʌv mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please sit down on the bench.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this chair free for customers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, that chair is still taken.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 在這裡有雜誌可以看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are on that small table.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ ɑr ɑn ðæt smɔl ˈteɪbəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a cup of coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə kʌp ʌv ˈkɔfi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee is free by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太好了，請給我一杯黑咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cream and sugar are beside it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the best barber here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡哪位理髮師技術最好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marco is our fastest and best.
dialogue.zh: Marco 是我們又快又好的那位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does Marco only cut men's hair?
dialogue.zh: Marco 只幫男生剪頭髮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son needs a haircut this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn nidz ə ˈhɛrˌkʌt ðɪs wiːk./
dialogue.zh: 我兒子這週需要剪頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring him, our kid chair is fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ hɪm ˈaʊər kɪd tʃɛr ɪz fʌn./
dialogue.zh: 帶他來吧，我們的小孩椅很有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a mirror I can use?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈmɪrər aɪ kæn juz?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有鏡子可以讓我照一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big mirror is by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ ˈmɪrər ɪz baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, when is Marco free?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，Marco 什麼時候有空？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will be ready in ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl bi ˈrɛdi ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, do you sell combs?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ du ju sɛl koʊmz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, see the shelf behind you.
dialogue.zh: 有的，看看你身後那排貨架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which comb is good for thick hair?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ koʊm ɪz ɡʊd fər θɪk hɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take a look later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place is cleaner than most.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們每晚都會清潔每張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here is the printed card.
dialogue.zh: 當然，這是印好的價目卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A normal cut is twenty dollars?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That price seems fair to me.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得這個價格算合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have kept prices stable for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv kɛpt ˈpraɪsɪz ˈsteɪbəl fər jɪrz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my son is a student.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can bring his card then.
dialogue.zh: 那他到時帶學生證來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take my jacket off?
dialogue.zh: 我要不要把外套脫下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will bring you a cape.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ju ə keɪp./
dialogue.zh: 要脫的，我會拿圍布給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we warm one before cutting.
dialogue.zh: 有，剪之前我們會先熱一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很多男生剪到一半會睡著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 說不定我今天也會睡一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I show you a photo?
dialogue.zh: 我可以給你看一張照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let me see your phone.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，讓我看看你的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a cut like this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə kʌt laɪk ðɪs wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, it suits your face.
dialogue.zh: 選得好，很適合你的臉型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this style hard to manage?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不難，每天早上五分鐘就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair is thick and wavy.
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮又厚又帶自然捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 自然捲反而讓這個髮型更好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you thin out the sides?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，打薄看起來更輕盈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pick an easy style for every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pɪk ən ˈizi staɪl fər ˈɛvri deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那就選個日常好打理的髮型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this cut need a blow-dryer?
dialogue.zh: 這個髮型需要吹風機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我早上時間很趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這個髮型可以幫你省時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me styles from this book.
dialogue.zh: 給我看看這本書裡的髮型。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, this page has short cuts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I really like the one with the fade.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈrɪli laɪk ði wʌn wɪð ðə feɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我超喜歡有漸層的那款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is our most popular cut.
dialogue.zh: 那款是我們最受歡迎的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a skin fade possible here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡可以推貼頭皮的漸層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, low, mid or high fades.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does a full cut take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ə fʊl kʌt teɪk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have time, so no rush.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we will do it right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the lot behind is free.
dialogue.zh: 免費，後面的停車場不收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your ticket just in case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love that, let us begin.
dialogue.zh: 我很喜歡挑戰，我們開始吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First visit here, everything looks great.
dialogue.zh: 第一次來，感覺樣樣都不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you cutting wet or dry?
dialogue.zh: 你會濕髮剪還是乾髮剪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wash it, then cut it damp.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɑʃ ɪt ðɛn kʌt ɪt dæmp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 請把我的髮際線留自然一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will not make it too sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl nɑt meɪk ɪt tu ʃɑrp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing about the back.
dialogue.zh: 後腦勺那邊還有個小要求。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, tell me what you want.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And leave some length on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much length do you want?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe two inches, we will check.
dialogue.zh: 大約兩英吋，剪的時候再看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will start with clippers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us start with the sides.
dialogue.zh: 我們先從兩側開始好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which clipper number should I use?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use number two on the sides.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two is short, are you sure?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, short sides look so clean.
dialogue.zh: 確定，短兩側看起來很清爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will go with two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blend the back into the sides.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will soften that line there.
dialogue.zh: 我會把那條線推得柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we add a fade today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A low fade looks very natural.
dialogue.zh: 低漸層看起來非常自然。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你說的是推光的漸層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不，會留一點短短的髮根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mid fade might look cooler.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, a mid fade works too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the fade nice and tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The taper should start quite low.
dialogue.zh: 漸層請從比較低的地方開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will start it near the neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl stɑrt ɪt nɪr ðə nɛk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ears stick out a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can leave length near them.
dialogue.zh: 可以在耳朵旁邊留點頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, trim close around the ears.
dialogue.zh: 不用，耳朵周圍推短就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This side is a little tricky.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go slowly around my left ear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, hold still for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will use scissors up there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two inches feels right on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should it be even all over?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bit shorter toward the front.
dialogue.zh: 靠近前面的地方再短些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will trim them nice and straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl trɪm ðɛm naɪs ænd streɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我會把瀏海剪得又齊又順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like them swept to one side.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðɛm swɛpt tə wʌn saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can point cut for texture.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will cut with the grain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the top lie flat after?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please thin out these thick patches.
dialogue.zh: 請把這幾處較厚的地方打薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want less bulk, not length.
dialogue.zh: 我要減少發量，不是長度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take just an inch off the ends.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk dʒʌst ən ɪntʃ ɔf ði ɛndz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 髮尾看起來確實有點乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My split ends have to go.
dialogue.zh: 分叉的髮尾一定要剪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round out the back a little.
dialogue.zh: 後面的輪廓請修圓一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A soft round shape, right away.
dialogue.zh: 柔和的圓弧線，馬上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some guys want a square shape.
dialogue.zh: 有些客人偏好方形的輪廓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long do you like them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will check twice for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 鬢角可以修飾臉的輪廓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, we will keep them neat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我修整髮際線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在就把線條推清楚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will use the straight razor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the razor hurt at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My forehead is big, be careful.
dialogue.zh: 我額頭大，請修得保守一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A soft line hides it well.
dialogue.zh: 柔和的線條能修飾額頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you want a hard part?
dialogue.zh: 要不要刻一條明顯的分線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will shave a thin line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I part left or right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the part in the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðə pɑrt ɪn ðə ˈmɪrər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That line looks a little deep.
dialogue.zh: 那條線看起來有點太深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好，淡淡的若有若無就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 層次會讓自然捲更有型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 後面的接合處處理好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，再用電剪走一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 幫我檢查有沒有漏剪的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel one near your collar.
dialogue.zh: 感覺衣領附近還有一處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spray feels great on my neck.
dialogue.zh: 噴霧噴在脖子上很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you check the fade once more?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju tʃɛk ðə feɪd wʌns mɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do we wash my hair?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I am ready for the wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ æm ˈrɛdi fər ðə wɑʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lean back slowly for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wash chair is so comfy.
dialogue.zh: 這張洗頭椅真的好舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will massage in the shampoo.
dialogue.zh: 我會邊按摩邊上洗髮精。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every cut includes a head massage.
dialogue.zh: 每次剪髮都附帶頭部按摩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you using conditioner here too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My scalp gets dry in winter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這瓶茶樹洗髮精有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water got in my ear there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you use the blow-dryer now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dryer is not too hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you keep the dryer moving?
dialogue.zh: 吹風機可以別對著一處嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will keep it moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have been busy all morning.
dialogue.zh: 你一整個上午都沒閒過呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but I still take short breaks.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt aɪ stɪl teɪk ʃɔrt breɪks./
dialogue.zh: 還好，我還是會抓空休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do clients talk to you a lot?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈklaɪənts tɔk tə ju ə lɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 客人們都很愛跟你聊天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, chatting is the best part.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔrs ˈtʃætɪŋ ɪz ðə bɛst pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 當然啦，聊天正是這行的樂趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a short walk actually.
dialogue.zh: 說實話我想站起來走一走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好呀，在櫃台附近活動一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No hurry at all, sit back down.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈhɜri æt ɔl sɪt bæk daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 一點都不急，請慢慢坐好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 當理髮師看起來很辛苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, but I love talking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many years have you cut hair?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni jɪrz hæv ju kʌt hɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 你入行剪頭髮幾年了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在理髮椅後面站了十年囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you train at a school?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這裡也幫女生設計髮型嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife would like a trim.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it always busy in here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Early birds get the best chairs.
dialogue.zh: 早起的客人有最好的座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 兩客之間會休息一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing all day must tire you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這聞起來是很棒的古龍水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We spray it at the end.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One mist is plenty for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 反正你聞起來都會很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個味道是我最喜歡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scent will last all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look in the mirror, say anything.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The right side looks a bit long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə raɪt saɪd lʊks ə bɪt lɔŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tidy it right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tiny snip, there we go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often do bangs need trims?
dialogue.zh: 瀏海多久需要修剪一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every two weeks keeps them neat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How did that end for him?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One side was way too short.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可憐的孩子，好在長回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kids keep you on your toes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The toy chair keeps them calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 小朋友剪髮比較便宜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will bring my son Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He always asks about the clippers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 嗡嗡聲會嚇到一些孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有些小孩在這裡會睡著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 還一分鐘，然後上造型品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you add a little wax?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 髮油看起來會亮亮的，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not want shiny hair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then clay wax is your pick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much product should I use?
dialogue.zh: 我每次該用多少造型品？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I rub it between my palms?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ rʌb ɪt bɪˈtwin maɪ pɑmz?/
dialogue.zh: 我該先在掌心把它搓開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, warm it between your hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, then press the top?
dialogue.zh: 像這樣，再輕壓一下頭頂？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, you pick it up fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮現在感覺變厚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some hair fell in my collar.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will brush it right off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is any hair left on my shoulders?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈɛni hɛr lɛft ɑn maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All clean, the cape comes off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the shape from the back?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɪz ðə ʃeɪp frʌm ðə bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 後面的線條看起來如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 後面修得圓圓的，很漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn me to the side mirror.
dialogue.zh: 幫我把椅子轉向側面鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see a little scalp there.
dialogue.zh: 那裡有一點看得到頭皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 二號本來就很短，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It grows back in two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是柔和感，不會刺刺的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is exactly what I wanted.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am glad you like it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的耳朵已經覺得輕多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每個客人都這樣開玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you shape my beard too?
dialogue.zh: 可以順便幫我修鬍子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要修臉頰線還是頸部線？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 鬍子現在看起來更俐落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它讓你的臉看起來瘦一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I settle the bill?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does that come to?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，在這裡感應或掃描。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen asks if you like.
dialogue.zh: 可以，在這裡感應或掃描。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will leave a generous tip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is very kind of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next visit, your wait will be short.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈvɪzɪt jər weɪt wɪl bi ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 下次來，等候時間會很短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a rewards card here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten cuts, then one is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I book my next visit?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the fourth of next month.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 星期五上午十點半好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 十點半剛好配合我的行程安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 訂好了，我會傳訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 訂好了，我會傳訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We call if you are late.
dialogue.zh: 如果你遲到我們會打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cancel a day before, no fee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這生日禮物主意真不賴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did I put my phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the small table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just my jacket, that is all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fresh towel for the ride home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə frɛʃ ˈtaʊəl fər ðə raɪd hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 你們還貼心準備了毛巾？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們還貼心準備了毛巾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們希望客人會再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we stay open all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind if I take this magazine home?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnd ɪf aɪ teɪk ðɪs ˈmæɡəˌzɪn hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 我把這本書雜誌帶回家可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it is yours to keep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它很適合你的乾性頭皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I grab a bottle before I go?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡræb ə ˈbɑtəl bɪˈfɔr aɪ ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我走之前可以先拿一瓶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 再見，謝謝這麼好的服務。
